command.instructions: What does the person want to do in their git repository?

criteria.status: See where things stand: the current branch, and which files are modified, staged or untracked
criteria.diff: See the uncommitted changes themselves, line by line
criteria.show: See one commit in detail: its message and what it changed
criteria.compare: See how one branch differs from another: the commits and files that are only on one of them
criteria.stash_list: List the changes that were put aside with stash
criteria.fetch: Download what is new on the remote without changing any local branch
criteria.stage: Stage changes for the next commit, without committing yet
criteria.unstage: Take changes out of the staging area, keeping the changes in the files
criteria.commit: Record the changes as a new commit
criteria.stash: Put uncommitted changes aside, to get a clean working tree
criteria.unstash: Bring back changes that were put aside with stash
criteria.switch: Switch the current checkout to another branch that already exists
criteria.delete_branch: Delete a branch whose work is already merged
criteria.merge: Bring another branch's commits into the current branch
criteria.pull: Update the current branch with the new commits on its remote
criteria.push: Upload the current branch's new commits to the remote
criteria.worktree_list: List the worktrees: the other directories where this repository is checked out, and their branches
criteria.worktree_add: Create a worktree: check out a branch, new or existing, in a directory of its own
criteria.worktree_path: Find the directory of one worktree, for example to go to it
criteria.worktree_remove: Remove a worktree whose work is finished
criteria.worktree_prune: Clean up worktrees whose directories were already deleted by hand
criteria.help: Asks what this can do, or how to use it
criteria.unsupported: Some other git operation, such as rebase, reset, cherry-pick, revert, tags, remotes or submodules

destructive.instructions: The request asks to throw away work or history: discard uncommitted changes, reset hard, clean untracked files, force-push, force-delete an unmerged branch, drop a stash, or force-remove a worktree that has changes

all_changes.instructions: The request wants every change included, including unstaged and untracked files, rather than only what is staged or only named files

staged.instructions: The request is only about the changes already staged for the next commit
